blocks.text: The Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) has stepped in to help stage the 108th Philippine Open, putting up a $1-million purse (roughly P63 million) for Asia’s oldest national golf championship set Nov. 12 at Manila Southwoods in Carmona, Cavite.
